review_2.token_shape: A '.'-separated piece, without '-' and '_', of at least 20 letters and digits mixing classes whose lowercase runs average under 3 bytes. On 40,000 simulated uniform base64url strings per length it refused 98.0% at 32, 99.2% at 43 and 99.8% at 64 characters; the test requires at least 96%, 98% and 99% of 2000 deterministic samples. A 0.4 class-change-rate rule was rejected because it refused digit-heavy CamelCase names.
